The '''ray shield generator''' on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] was built by [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] built to [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]] his [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|droid foundries]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The fortress and its [[Ray shield generator/Legends|ray shield generator]] were destroyed during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]].
